ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ProdCzynnosci_AktualizujPKJN' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.ProdCzynnosci_AktualizujPKJN

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.ProdCzynnosci_AktualizujPKJN ON CDN.ProdCzynnosci FOR DELETE AS begin SET NOCOUNT ON UPDATE CDN.ProdPKJNag SET PKJN_PCZId = 0 FROM deleted d WHERE PKJN_PCZId = d.PCZ_Id SET NOCOUNT OFF end
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'ProdZlecenia_AktualizujPKJN' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.ProdZlecenia_AktualizujPKJN

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.ProdZlecenia_AktualizujPKJN ON CDN.ProdZlecenia FOR DELETE AS begin SET NOCOUNT ON UPDATE CDN.ProdPKJNag SET PKJN_PZLId = 0 FROM deleted d WHERE PKJN_PCZId = d.PZL_Id SET NOCOUNT OFF end
